nodes.name: Agent Operating Runtime Contract v1.0
nodes.summary: Markdown document "Agent Operating Runtime Contract v1.0" (guideline/contract, 199 lines): This contract converts project-level operating guides into centralized GWC behavior for ChatGPT-style agents, DWC, local coding agents, and project consumer agents.

nodes.name: E2E Draft PR Delivery Rule
nodes.summary: Markdown document "E2E Draft PR Delivery Rule" (document, 407 lines): Allow the agent to complete an approved coding task end-to-end and deliver a validated Draft Pull Request for final user review.

nodes.name: G5 CI Verification Contract v1.0
nodes.summary: Markdown document "G5 CI Verification Contract v1.0" (guideline/contract, 146 lines): This contract defines the read-only G5 status-verification runtime for GitHub Actions after a G4 merge. It turns the existing exact-SHA rule into an executable resolver, evidence bundle, and checkpoint protocol.

nodes.name: G5 Standing Automation Policy v1.0
nodes.summary: Markdown document "G5 Standing Automation Policy v1.0" (guideline/contract, 68 lines): - Document ID: `g5-standing-automation-policy` - Version: `1.0` - Lifecycle: `active` - Scope: `nhatnguyenquang1838-coder/gwc` - Related work: `SCRUM-143`, `SCRUM-151`

nodes.name: GWC Gate Lifecycle Contract v1.1
nodes.summary: Markdown document "GWC Gate Lifecycle Contract v1.1" (guideline/contract, 267 lines): This contract defines the required entry evidence, permitted actions, exit evidence, and authority boundary for G0 through G6. It extends the existing G0/G1 artifact lifecycle without replacing it.

nodes.name: HUMAN BYPASS Contract v1.0
nodes.summary: Markdown document "HUMAN BYPASS Contract v1.0" (guideline/contract, 93 lines): `HUMAN BYPASS` is a one-time operational handoff for one exact workflow step that the agent cannot execute through the verified tool route. It is not a policy override, gate skip, blanket approval, or substitute for evidence.

nodes.name: Interrupt Flow Contract v1.0
nodes.summary: Markdown document "Interrupt Flow Contract v1.0" (guideline/contract, 103 lines): This contract defines the shared interrupt mechanism used by GWC runtime nodes when a workflow cannot safely continue on the current linear path without first refreshing evidence, authority, or repository state.

nodes.name: Kiro Spec-Driven Delivery Rule v1.0
nodes.summary: Markdown document "Kiro Spec-Driven Delivery Rule v1.0" (specification, 269 lines): --- policy_id: KIRO_SPEC_DRIVEN_DELIVERY_RULE version: "1.0" status: active authoritative: false policy_scope: reusable_spec_planning_and_delivery applies_to: - feature_planning - non_trivial_implementation - ui_redesign - architecture_change - migration ---

nodes.name: Local Agent Rule
nodes.summary: Markdown document "Local Agent Rule" (document, 105 lines): This rule applies to an agent running on a user's local machine with access to a local filesystem, shell, repository checkout, Git, and worktrees.

nodes.name: Runtime Catalog Knowledge Graph Contract v1.0
nodes.summary: Markdown document "Runtime Catalog Knowledge Graph Contract v1.0" (guideline/contract, 125 lines): This contract standardizes the language and graph shape for the GWC runtime catalog so agents can distinguish gates, capability families, runtime nodes, edge scenarios, and artifacts without inventing parallel terminology.
